summary: 桂枝汤：网络药理学假说（种子语料）；预测 ≠ 实测
text: Herb–target network for 桂枝汤 from the seed corpus. Every target edge is a corpus-recorded relation or a network inference; none is a binding measurement. It supports a mechanism hypothesis at most.

artifact.question: what target network is inferred for 桂枝汤?

sources.name: TCMScience TCM seed corpus
known_limits: seed corpus only: 23 herbs, 5 processed forms, 6 formulas, 8 syndromes, 9 passages, 2 study records, 14 relations, 14 safety records
no clinical study data is included; every study record is at EXPERT_EXPERIENCE or below
coverage is illustrative, not exhaustive; absence from this corpus is not evidence of absence
sources.notes: Compiled into the package. Declared as a source so a resolution can be traced to the corpus that produced it.
sources.citation: TCMScience · TCMScience TCM seed corpus 0.2.6 · https://github.com/psknlr/TCMScience · snapshot b376a9d13224 at 2026-09-25T00:00:00Z

limitations: EVERY target edge here is a corpus-recorded relation or a network inference; none is a binding measurement. No docking, no assay, no structure-based prediction was run
pathway enrichment is a ranked list of recorded predicates, not a background-corrected enrichment analysis; no network randomisation was performed, so no p-value is reported
the network is built from the seed corpus only; no external target database (BindingDB, ChEMBL, STITCH) was queried
a predicted edge is a hypothesis about a mechanism. It is not evidence that the formula treats any condition in any patient

no measured target data exists for this formula in the corpus, so the measured side of the split is empty; measured targets come from the snapshot pipeline (analysis.network_pharmacology), not this corpus
the corpus records no molecular target relation for this formula or its herbs, so no target network was built and no claim is made
recorded indications (treats / indicated_for) are traditional-use records whose object is a syndrome; they are reported apart and are not targets
assumptions: corpus-recorded relations are treated as hypotheses about mechanism
absence of a measured edge means no measurement was found, not that binding was tested and excluded

environment.note: installed versions of bioagent, psh and bioagent's declared runtime dependencies, transitively; 'missing' means declared but not installed

warnings.detail: artifact makes no claims; it reports material but asserts nothing
